caption: The drawing depicts a teacup and a matching bowl, both shown in actual size as indicated by a label at the bottom left of the image. The teacup is situated above the bowl and is depicted with a single curved handle on the right side. Both objects are predominantly white with decorative bands near the rims consisting of purple and gold colors. The band design features arches outlined in gold, filled with darker purple, and decorated with a chain of small pink or purple motifs and dots. The teacup has a thin purple band near its base along with a similar band circling the rim, and the inner rim also accentuated with a gold line. The bowl features the same decorative band near its rim, and inside the bowl at the bottom, there is a floral pattern in purple. The background is off-white, surrounded by a thin, rectangular drawn border. The artist's signature, "T.A. Holloway," is present in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Cup and Saucer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
